北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天阳光正好，体感稍凉，记得适时添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny today, feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪雾气弥漫，能见度低，出行请注意安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, visibility is low. Please travel safely!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气较大，能见度不高，开车慢些，注意安全哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy with low visibility. Drive carefully and stay safe!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾蒙蒙的，体感有点热，记得多喝水、保持清爽哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy and feels quite warm. Stay hydrated and cool!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾，体感偏热，出行注意防潮和交通安全！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy and warm. Watch out for humidity and traffic safety!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雾气较浓，能见度一般。出门注意安全，小心慢行。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy with moderate visibility. Be careful and drive slowly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾气重，能见度低，外出务必注意交通安全哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is very foggy, visibility is low. Please ensure road safety when going out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温舒适。记得带把伞，以防小雨哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Bring an umbrella for slight drizzles.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天风力较大，出门注意防风保暖，避免着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with strong winds. Remember to keep warm and windproof to avoid catching a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感有些凉，记得穿暖和点，小心着凉哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels cool. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿度高，体感稍凉。注意防潮保暖哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with high humidity and feels cool. Keep warm and stay positive!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨风大很冷，请多穿保暖衣物，防寒防风哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels very cold with strong winds. Be sure to wear warm clothes and stay bundled up!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感有点冷，多穿几层，暖暖和和出门哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels cold. Layer up and stay warm when you go out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感舒适。湿度高，心情也要美美哒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and comfortable. Enjoy the pleasant weather and high humidity!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门雾气较重，体感热，出行小心慢行，多补充水分。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is very foggy and warm. Drive carefully and stay hydrated!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天风力大，体感比较冷。注意防风，多加衣物哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with strong winds and feels quite cold. Dress warmly and stay windproof!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，风大体感冷，请穿厚实些，小心保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels very cold with strong winds. Dress warmly and bundle up!
